verdict.rationale: The docs describe both scopes. The default install is global, via the plugin marketplace commands. The documented alternative is project-local: copy the same skill folders into the repo's `.claude/skills/`, where they can live alongside the code. Missing for 10: the global install location is never stated explicitly, committing the skills to the repo is only implied, project-local install is a manual copy rather than a scope flag, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
